title: Protect persisted Research context pin state across repository reload
root_cause: Pin/unpin service behavior was implemented, but no regression closed the persistence contract across separate repository sessions.

change.behavior: Added a repository-lifecycle test that pins an exact persisted Result, reloads session memory, unpins it, and reloads again.

assertions: Pinned Result ID survives transaction close and a fresh repository session.
Unpin mutation is persisted and observed by a later repository read.
Scientific Result authority remains immutable; only session context state changes.
